description: igme.es: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by igme.es. Coverage: igme.es. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: EGS Landslide Density Database; CARTOGRAPHY OF ROCKFALLS SOURCE AREAS IN THE ISLAND OF EL HIERRO, CANA; CARTOGRAPHY OF ROCKFALLS SUSCEPTIBILITY IN THE ISLAND OF EL HIERRO, CA. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
